decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet is cheap to keep in the accessories collection, and with industry turnover growing there is no performance shortfall to trigger problemistic search, though carpet collections are refreshed periodically.
This hand-knotted wool silk carpet embodies the firm's craftsmanship and fine-materials positioning, and organisational slack allows it to carry a slow-selling premium piece.
This carpet overlaps with A and E, so it is the likeliest candidate for pruning in a collection refresh, but without an aspiration shortfall the firm has little reason to act now.
This low-pile carpet adds little cost or complexity close to the core offer, and the firm's satisfactory performance gives no trigger to withdraw it.
This multi-model swivel shell chair line represents a substantial investment serving residential, workplace and public interiors, so it is very likely to stay.
